description.value:
Frequency once per round

Trigger You Name the Anchor.

As part of the same action, draw one Ward-Scrawled Charm and tear or burn it. The Charm resolves whether or not you succeed at Naming the Anchor, and it is spent either way. You must have a hand free to draw it.

cinderfall.incomplete: Links consuming a held consumable item (Ward-Scrawled Charm) to a different action's resolution as a free action with no numeric effect of its own. No rule element automates 'consume this held item automatically when action X resolves' -- that is scripted automation, out of scope for a rule-element pass by default.
